commentary: H100 on-demand rates have collapsed to $1.49-3.85/hr (median ~$3.38-4.17/hr) as Blackwell ships, down ~50% since early 2024, while H200 sits at $2.60-4.50/hr and B200 at $3.95-8.19/hr. The depreciation divergence is stark: Meta extended AI server life to 5.5 years (adding $2.9B to 2025 earnings) the same month Amazon shortened it to 5 years citing AI innovation pace, revealing acute uncertainty about economic vs. accounting life. CoreWeave's bond yields (11.5-13%) and CDS spreads (50% implied 5yr default probability) signal credit markets pricing GPU collateral risk and the refinancing wall, even as the company reports $104B backlog—the waterfall is repricing faster than the depreciation schedules admit.
